notes: v645 - ONE BUTTON for the rules the testing settled on. Open My Rules and press the green 'Use the tested rules' button at the top of the Auto-pilot section. It fills in every number AND SAVES it, then reads the whole set back to you so there is no doubt what is live. This exists because the settings were spread across two places - a preset chip set the exits, price band and entry, the best-practice button set the source and gates, and NEITHER of them saved. That made a half-applied state easy to reach and impossible to spot: tap Hunter, tap Defender by accident, and your exits quietly become Defender's while the bot half still looks right. The rules it applies: a 20% TRAILING stop with no take-profit and no fixed stop, shares priced $0.20 to $0.99, a patient limit 5% under the last close, the best proven scan with a minimum score of 7, two buys a day, ten percent max in one share across five positions, and the usual guards. Over the full ~2.9 years of stored history after brokerage and slippage that set returned +145.5%, against +52.5% for 20% target / 15% stop and +45.7% for 15/15 - and it stayed ahead even with its three biggest winners removed. What it costs you, measured rather than guessed: about half these trades lose, positions are held around 50 days instead of days, and every winner gives back 20% from its peak before it exits. That give-back is the mechanism working. Change any number afterwards and press Save my rules to override. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
